# Label list — DSO183 custom firmware

Labels used on issues and pull requests. Maintainers apply these when triaging;
contributors are welcome to suggest labels but should not self-assign
maintainer-only labels.

## By area

| Label | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `firmware` | Core firmware code (`app/`, `drivers/`, `startup/`, `linker/`) |
| `acquisition/DSP` | ADC, trigger, timebase, measurements, waveform decimation/rendering |
| `hardware` | Pin map, board bring-up, display controller, front panel |
| `UI` | Menus, display rendering, front-panel navigation |
| `documentation` | `docs/`, README, issue/PR templates |
| `tooling` | Build system, flash tools, test harness, `tools/` |
| `good first issue` | Suitable for new contributors |

## By kind

| Label | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `bug` | Something isn't working correctly |
| `enhancement` | New feature or improvement |
| `question` | Support or usage question |
| `discussion` | Open-ended topic for community input |

## By verification status (behaviour claims)

| Label | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `verified-bench` | Observed working on real hardware |
| `verified-host` | Proven by host unit tests only |
| `unverified` | Theoretical, not yet verified |

## Maintenance

| Label | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `maintainer` | Maintainer-only action needed |
| `blocked` | Blocked on external input or decision |

See `CONTRIBUTING.md` for how labels are used in triage and review.
